### 对预测市场的含义
- 若 Warsh 讲话证实市场“鹰派押注”，利率相关合约或偏向鹰派定价（[路透社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxOR0w3QnNOYVBGYjdBMGJDeml5RExhSzMzaGVTUEQ2eEdLNHhHQzRoV2thNUo4TkVGYmNfc3NsSGpVVVF2OWxCZ21CNzBMSGs0S3NuZ2Rla1d4WTR0RGJwcllfYnZ6dlR5ZGZXa3dMakUxZmNDWFExYk9HNTkyLTN6aWF0MlRRbzN4aUJUVnVCMk1fdlpVN1B0bE1QM3dkaENDNEwzaHRORFFjVDYw?oc=5)、[华尔街日报](https://www.wsj.com/finance/currencies/singapore-dollar-consolidates-but-may-be-weighed-by-risk-off-sentiment-1a00f31b?mod=rss_markets_main)）
- 英伟达财报由临时 CEO 主持，若黄仁勋复职等人事进展出现，相关科技事件合约需重新评估（[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/16/nvidia-earnings-jensen-huang-resignation.html)、[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cry49plv8v3go?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)）
- 政府拨款谈判受扰，停摆相关合约偏向上行（[The Hill](https://thehill.com/homenews/house/6219857-democrats-clash-funding-iran/)）
